description: Edge case: File deleted externally after read, system detects and retries
prompt:
1. Read src/temp.js:
<context-item use="read-file">
{"path": "src/temp.js"}
</context-item>

2. Try to edit it using replace-text:
<action execute="replace-text">
{"path": "src/temp.js", "old_str": "export const TEMP", "new_str": "export const TEMP = 'modified'; // was"}
</action>

NOTE: The file will be deleted externally. System should detect this as an external change and retry. On retry, the file won't exist and the edit should fail gracefully with a clear error.

3. After observing the behavior, write your findings to ERROR_LOG.md. Document whether the system detected the external file deletion and how it handled the error.
